intent: To demonstrate the increasing trend of reported rape cases in India from 2008 to 2016.

requirements.question: Must the video show an overall upward trend across the full 2008–2016 period, even if it does not annotate every year?
Must the 2016 endpoint value, and/or its status as the highest year, be explicitly conveyed?

units.claim: Reported rape cases in India trend upward over 2008–2016, from 19,923.404 in 2008 to 37,923.404 in 2016.
accept: Reported rape cases generally increased from 2008 to 2016.
The series rises overall from about 19,900 in 2008 to about 37,900 in 2016.
There is an upward trend across the period, despite year-to-year variation.
units.evidence: A line/bar series for 2008–2016 must visibly ascend overall; the start and end years should be identifiable.

units.claim: The 2016 endpoint is the maximum shown: 37,923.404 reported cases, higher than all earlier years.

basis.note: final and highest year in the series

accept: In 2016, reported rape cases reached about 37,900.
The final year, 2016, ends at 37,923.404 cases.
2016 is the highest year shown, at roughly 37,900 reported cases.
units.evidence: The 2016 bar/point must be labeled or clearly end the series at its highest level.

optional_valid: 2008 and 2009 are equal at 19,923.404 reported cases.
The total increase from 2008 to 2016 is 18,000 cases, about +90.3%.
2015 is lower than 2014 but still higher than 2013.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
